title: nciwyOptimized
body:
⚡ OPTIMIZATION MODPACK FOR BETTER FPS

Welcome! This is a client-side optimization and utility modpack designed to significantly increase FPS, improve performance, and enhance your gameplay experience while keeping the Vanilla Minecraft feel. All included mods are strictly client-side, meaning you can use this modpack on any multiplayer server!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🛠️ MOD LIST

Fabric API, Sodium, Iris, Cloth Config API, Entity Culling, Mod Menu, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast, YACL, Fabric Language Kotlin, Sodium Extra, 3D Skin Layers, Continuity, Simple Voice Chat, Dynamic FPS, FPS Display, Zoomify, Text Placeholder API, Mouse Tweaks, Krypton, BadOptimizations, More Chat History, Clumps, CustomSkinLoader, Litematica, STFU, Flashback, ScalableLux, Async Particles, FerriteCore, More Culling.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTE FOR NVIDIA USERS (GTX 1600+ / RTX)

💡 ATTENTION
If you are using an NVIDIA 1600+ GPU, this pack does not include the Nvidium mod automatically, because the original project on Modrinth was discontinued.

To get a massive FPS boost with your graphics card, follow these steps:

1. Find latest version of Nvidium here-https://github.com/drouarb/nvidium/releases
2. Download the `.jar` file matching your Minecraft version.
3. Drop it manually into your `mods` folder after installing this modpack.
